question: In a certain code language, 'NATION' is written as 'MZGRLM' and 'PRINTS' is written as 'KIRMGH'. How will 'BOTTLE' be written in that language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] Logic : Opposite letter according to English alphabetic series is written. ​So, • 'NATION' is written as 'MZGRLM'
